## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters (almost always present)

```sql
-- Date partition (always required)
WHERE dt = '${BIZ_DT}'                           -- Single day
WHERE date(dt) = '${BIZ_DT}'                     -- Date cast variant
WHERE TO_DATE(dt) = TO_DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')    -- Function-based variant

-- Region filter (standard 8 regions)
WHERE country IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')  -- Search Ads regions
WHERE country IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')   -- All 8 regions

-- Hour filter (not always used, table has hourly granularity)
WHERE h = ${BIZ_H}                               -- Specific hour

-- Placement filter (critical for ad type scoping)
WHERE placement = 40                             -- Search Ads
WHERE placement = 100                            -- Discovery Ads
```

### Timezone Handling (UTC+7/8 vs UTC+0 regions)

```sql
-- UTC+0 regions (SG, MY, PH, TW): Direct to_date
SELECT country AS grass_region,
       TO_DATE(idx.dt) AS grass_date
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log idx
WHERE idx.country IN ('PH','MY','SG','TW')
  AND TO_DATE(idx.dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}') AND TO_DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')

UNION ALL

-- UTC+7/8 regions (ID, TH, VN): h=0 belongs to previous day
SELECT country AS grass_region,
       DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(idx.dt), CASE WHEN idx.h = 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS grass_date
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log idx
WHERE idx.country IN ('ID','TH','VN')
  AND ((TO_DATE(idx.dt) BETWEEN '${start}' AND '${end}' AND idx.h BETWEEN 1 AND 23)
       OR (TO_DATE(idx.dt) = DATE_ADD('${end}', 1) AND idx.h = 0))
```

### Pricing Type Filters

```sql
AND advertisement.pricing_type = 11               -- Target ROI2
AND advertisement.pricing_type = 15               -- Simple ROI2
AND advertisement.pricing_type IN (11, 15)         -- Both ROI2 types
AND advertisement.pricing_type = 4                 -- Simple
```

### Bitmask / ad_tag Filters

```sql
-- Check if specific bit is set (bitwise AND)
AND (ad_tag_bitmask & advertisement.ad_tag) != 0

-- Extract specific bit positions
MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 31)) AS empty_flag        -- Empty spend
MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 34)) AS cold_start_flag    -- Cold start
MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 50)) AS npb_flag           -- NPB (New Product Boost) break-even
MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 53)) AS new_advertiser_ads_flag -- New advertiser
```

### Dedup Pattern (latest record per ads_id)

```sql
-- PySpark: latest record per ads_id x region x date by timestamp
window_spec = Window.partitionBy("ads_id", "grass_date", "grass_region").orderBy(F.col("timestamp").desc())
df.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
  .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
  .drop("rn")
```

### JOIN with Performance Table (ads-level metrics)

```sql
-- PySpark: Join with dwd_advertise_performance for daily performance
```

### JOIN with dim_advertise for Campaign/Shop/Item Enrichment

```sql
-- Spark SQL: Get campaign_id, item_id, shop_id from dim_advertise
SELECT DISTINCT ads_id, item_id, shop_id, campaign_id, grass_date, grass_region
FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
WHERE is_ads_active = 1
  AND grass_date = '{grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = '{grass_region}'
```

### Self-JOIN for Budget from Struct Fields

```sql
-- Extract campaign daily_budget from index ads info
WITH budget AS (
    SELECT
        i.country AS grass_region,
        i.campaign_id,
        i.ads_id,
        i.dt AS grass_date,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN i.campaign.daily_budget = 0 OR i.campaign.daily_budget > i.account.balance
                THEN i.account.balance
                ELSE i.campaign.daily_budget
            END
        ) / 1e5 AS campaign_daily_budget_local
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log i
    WHERE dt = '${BIZ_TIME}'
      AND country IN ('SG','VN','TH','TW','PH','MY','ID')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
```

### JOIN with Perf Predictor (ROI3)

```sql
-- SQL: Join for campaign-level ROAS prediction
WITH index_campaign AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, placement, campaign_id
    FROM (
        SELECT country AS grass_region, date(dt) AS grass_date, placement, campaign_id
        FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log
        WHERE date(dt) = CAST('${BIZ_TIME}' AS DATE)
          AND country IN ('ID','TH','TW','VN','MY','SG','PH','BR')
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
    ) a
    JOIN ads_info b USING (grass_region, placement, campaign_id)
)
```

### Campaign-Level Aggregation

```sql
-- Aggregate from ads-level to campaign-level
SELECT
    country AS grass_region,
    campaign_id,
    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN campaign.daily_budget = 0 OR campaign.daily_budget > account.balance
            THEN account.balance
            ELSE campaign.daily_budget
        END
    ) / 1e5 AS campaign_valid_budget_local
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log
WHERE dt = '${BIZ_TIME}'
  AND country IN ('SG','VN','TH','TW','PH','MY','ID')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### 1. Traffic Boost - Candidate Pool (PySpark)

```python
# Read index_ads_info_log with plan bucket filtering
index_ads_df = (
    spark.table("mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log")
    .select(
        F.col("country").alias("grass_region"),
        F.to_date("dt").alias("grass_date"),
        "campaign_id",
        F.col("advertisement.ad_tag").alias("ad_tag"),
        F.col("advertisement.plan_bucket_list").alias("plan_bucket_list"),
        F.col("campaign.daily_budget").alias("campaign_daily_budget"),
        F.col("account.balance").alias("account_balance"),
    )
    .where(
        F.col("country").isin(regions)
        & (F.to_date("dt") == F.lit(run_date))
    )
    .withColumn("campaign_seller_budget",
        F.when(F.col("campaign_daily_budget") == 0,
               F.col("account_balance"))
        .otherwise(F.col("campaign_daily_budget")))
)
```

### 3. Bidding Daily Report - Status Tags (Spark SQL)

```sql
SELECT
    date(dt) AS grass_date,
    country AS grass_region,
    ads_id,
    MAX(advertisement.plan_bucket_list[0]) AS plan_id,
    MAX(advertisement.plan_bucket_list[1]) AS plan_id_l2,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 50)) > 0 THEN 'npb'
        WHEN MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 53)) > 0 THEN 'new_advertiser_ads'
        WHEN MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 34)) > 0 THEN 'cold'
        WHEN MAX(getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, 31)) > 0 THEN 'empty'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END AS status_tag
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log
WHERE dt = '${BIZ_TIME}'
  AND country IN ('ID','SG','TH','PH','TW','MY','VN')
  AND placement = 40
  AND advertisement.pricing_type = 11
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### 4. Boost Service - Campaign Scope Daily (Spark SQL)

```sql
WITH index_daily_src AS (
    -- UTC+0 regions: direct mapping
    SELECT
        idx.country AS grass_region,
        TO_DATE(idx.dt) AS grass_date,
        idx.campaign_id,
        idx.h AS local_h,
        idx.advertisement.ad_tag AS ad_tag,
        idx.advertisement.plan_bucket_list AS plan_bucket_list,
        idx.bid_strategy.target_roi AS target_roi,
        CAST(idx.advertisement.ads_first_delivery_time AS BIGINT) AS ads_first_delivery_time
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log idx
    WHERE idx.country IN ('PH','MY','SG','TW')
      AND TO_DATE(idx.dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('${start}') AND TO_DATE('${end}')
    UNION ALL
    -- UTC+7/8 regions: h=0 belongs to previous day
    SELECT
        idx.country AS grass_region,
        DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(idx.dt), CASE WHEN idx.h = 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS grass_date,
        idx.campaign_id,
        pmod(idx.h - 1, 24) AS local_h,
        idx.advertisement.ad_tag AS ad_tag,
        idx.advertisement.plan_bucket_list AS plan_bucket_list,
        idx.bid_strategy.target_roi AS target_roi,
        CAST(idx.advertisement.ads_first_delivery_time AS BIGINT) AS ads_first_delivery_time
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log idx
    WHERE idx.country IN ('ID','TH','VN')
      AND ((TO_DATE(idx.dt) BETWEEN '${start}' AND '${end}' AND idx.h BETWEEN 1 AND 23)
           OR (TO_DATE(idx.dt) = DATE_ADD('${end}', 1) AND idx.h = 0))
)
```

### 6. ROI3 Voucher Analysis (Spark SQL)

```sql
SELECT
    t.advertisement.ad_tag,
    CASE WHEN t.advertisement.level = 4 THEN 'HOT_ITEM' END AS level,
    t.item.min_price_v2 AS min_price_v2,
    item_id, shop_id, ads_id, h
```

### 7. Subsidy Target Calculation (PySpark SQL)

```sql
SELECT
    campaign_id,
    aggregate(
        collect_set(advertisement.ad_tag),
        CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
        (acc, x) -> acc | x
    ) AS ad_tag,
    MIN(advertisement.first_delivery_time) AS first_delivery_time,
    FIRST(item.ctime) AS item_create_time
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log
WHERE dt = '{BIZ_DAY_MINUS1}'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Downstream Write (Tables that write FROM this table)

The only downstream write found is `ads_index_item_invert_index` (item-to-ads inverted index):

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ads_index_item_invert_index PARTITION (dt='${BIZ_DT}', h=${BIZ_H}, country)
SELECT item_id, collect_set(ads_id), country
FROM mkplpaidads_data.index_ads_info_log
WHERE dt='${BIZ_DT}' AND h=${BIZ_H} AND placement=40
GROUP BY item_id, country
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

*This is an entity table with no numeric metrics. All metric derivations are done in downstream performance/aggregation tables that JOIN with this table for dimension information.*

Common derived fields from struct access:
- `CASE WHEN campaign.daily_budget = 0 THEN account.balance ELSE campaign.daily_budget END` -- effective campaign budget
- `getbit(advertisement.ad_tag, N)` -- bitmask flag extraction for status tags
- `advertisement.plan_bucket_list[0]`, `advertisement.plan_bucket_list[1]` -- plan bucket levels
